summary: Unidentified male swimming with friends in the Colorado River ~6 mi north of Dotsero went underwater ~3:45 p.m. Sunday and did not surface; located miles downstream, recovered unresponsive to CPR; not wearing a PFD, reported not a strong swimmer
location: Colorado River ~6 mi north of Dotsero

notes: Unidentified at publication; Eagle County Coroner determining cause of death and notifying family.
